summary: Existing tools rely on passive forums or heavyweight B2B scheduling, leaving a gap for low-friction, skill-balanced team matchmaking at hackathons.

competitors.name: Devpost
competitors.summary: A global hackathon management platform providing project showcases, judging infrastructure, and public participant team-finding discussion boards.
competitors.differentiator: Relies on passive message boards where attendees browse and reach out manually to form project groups.
competitors.idea: Comprehensive hackathon hosting, project submission, and developer portfolio platform.
competitors.shortBio: Devpost is the leading platform for hosting virtual and in-person hackathons, developer showcases, and project submissions.
competitors.howWeDiffer: We actively match complementary teammates using low-friction data intake instead of relying on manual community forum postings.

competitors.name: Brella
competitors.summary: An event networking platform using intent-based AI algorithms to schedule structured one-on-one meetings between attendees.
competitors.differentiator: Focuses on pre-scheduled business development meetings at commercial conferences rather than dynamic project team formation.
competitors.idea: Intent-driven matchmaking platform for corporate event meetings and conferences.
competitors.shortBio: Brella provides AI-driven matchmaking and networking tools to facilitate targeted business connections at conferences.
competitors.howWeDiffer: We specialize in skill-balanced developer team creation instead of executive one-on-one corporate calendar scheduling.

competitors.name: Donut
competitors.summary: A chat-based integration tool that automatically pairs community or team members for casual introductions and social bonding.
competitors.differentiator: Employs randomized or basic lottery pairings inside Slack rather than skill- and role-weighted team composition algorithms.
competitors.idea: Chatbot-driven social introductions and randomized networking for distributed teams.
competitors.shortBio: Donut builds automated social introduction and employee engagement bots for Slack and Microsoft Teams.
competitors.howWeDiffer: We match hackers by technical competencies and project ambitions rather than facilitating random conversational coffee chats.

market_landscape: Current event networking solutions split between passive forum-based team listings and heavyweight corporate meeting schedulers with burdensome onboarding.
our_positioning: We position ourselves as a frictionless matchmaking engine that minimizes participant onboarding effort to automatically deliver balanced hackathon teams.
